Package com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update.changelog

Class ChangelogManager

java.lang.Object
com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update.changelog.ChangelogManager
public class ChangelogManager extends Object
Manages and parses changelog files for update history display. Supports Markdown format with automatic parsing and HTML rendering.
